Switch atlas: from the account in use to a standby one

Every state of a switch on every surface, drawn by cl_audit's own views through the render harness (Checks/render/pages/main.swift, ATLAS_SWITCH=1), each state set up through the app's own paths. Std look. Sample data: profile Main with ann@example.com in use and ben@example.com on standby; profile Work on cat@example.com; dan@example.com is no profile's. Menus are the app's own menu items drawn as their words. Click a picture to see it larger.

What each state should show

StateWhat every surface should showRule
01Before: ann in use (the Claude app and Claude Code on ann); ann's numbers (week 40%); ben on standby, "last in use 3 days ago", no numbers. Keys: Switch account › ben…; no Log in…A, B2
02ann's week full: ann in use, ann's week full with when it's back; ben offered first everywhere: "Switch to ben…" in both menus, ben picked in the card's tray, the alert's Switch account… button; the Switch page with ben pickedA, B
03Switch page open: NOW ann, TO ben; the steps: close the window, back up and move 6 Code-tab sessions and 2 tasks, Claude Code's sign-in. Every other surface as in 01B, §8
04aSwitching: the window closing: step 1 under way, Cancel offered; nothing moved yet, so every other surface still has ann in use with ann's numbersB
04bSwitching: moving: step 2 (backup, then the sessions and tasks); no Cancel (the move ends by itself); other surfaces still annB, §8
04cSwitching: the sign-in waited for: sessions and tasks under ben now (Undo possible); Claude Code still on ann, so every surface still has ann in use; the waiting alert (Show switch, Cancel switch), never an addressB, §8
05Done, the Claude app still on ann: Claude Code on ben, the app on ann: ann is in use (the app's account, A); the numbers are Claude Code's on ben and say so; the page: "Claude Code on ben · the Claude app still on ann"; the switch is linked (no Undo); ben not shown on standby and in use at onceA, B, B2
06Done, the app on ben: ben in use everywhere with ben's numbers; ann on standby ("last in use just now", her last week remembered); Switch account › ann…; nothing on standby twiceA, B2
07The sign-in landed on another account: Claude Code on dan (no profile's): the profile follows its folder, ann goes to standby, ben stays on standby; the app still on ann, so ann is in use by A's rule and the numbers say they are Claude Code's on dan; the page says another account signed in, and offers Undo while the move is openA, B, B2
08Timed out: no sign-in in 10 minutes: Claude Code still on ann, so ann in use with ann's numbers; the sessions already under ben (Undo and Try again offered)B, B4
09Stopped part way: the window opened during the move: 2 sessions under ben, the rest under ann; the move step failed, the tile says how many are still moved and that Undo puts them back; Undo on the page and the Sessions card; ann in useB4, §8
10Partly undone: Undo left 1 session that changed since, the rest is back; the page says partly undone and what was left; the Sessions card offers Undo again and Leave it as it is; ann in useB4, §8
11The folder gone: Main's Claude Code folder deleted: the switch refused before anything (not started, nothing changed), said in one line naming the folder; no sign-in startedA, B4
12Cancelled before starting: Cancel while the window was closing: nothing moved; everything as in 01 (ann in use, ben on standby)B
  • A: one record every surface reads (AccountResolver); the account in use is the Claude app's
  • A3: no numbers when expired or signed out; Log in… the one key
  • B: the switch moves the window's Code-tab sessions and tasks; the app is signed in by the person
  • B2: one standby entry per account; the account in use never on standby too
  • B4: the step that failed, and what is still moved
  • §8: the claude-transplant model: backup first, receipts, Undo until linked

Findings: 14

  1. 04c/settings: shows while the switch is only waiting for Claude Code's sign-in (the page: "Switching · waiting", Cancel), the Sessions card already says "A switch stopped … stopped before Claude Code signed in as ben" with Undo it, Leave it as it is and Not now. SessionsCard picks any unfinished receipt and never asks whether its switch is still running. The table says 04c: the sign-in is waited for; nothing has stopped. Undo belongs to the page (B, §8); Leave it as it is only once a switch stopped part way (B4).
  2. 05/settings: shows the Accounts card has ann IN USE with "Usage: Claude Code on ben", and right under it the note "Switched today … · was ann@example.com, now on standby". ben has no row of its own. The table says 05: ann is in use (A: the app's account) and is not on standby too (B2); ben is Claude Code's account and should be named as such.
  3. 07/settings: shows the same note as 05, "was ann@example.com, now on standby", under ann IN USE; dan, whose numbers fill the bars, has no row anywhere. The table says 07: ann in use by A's rule; one account, one place (B2).
  4. 07/switch: shows Back says "Main works on dan now, and ann is on standby", while the same page's NOW box (and the card, both menus, the Dock panel and Settings) has ann IN USE. The table says 07: ann is in use (the app is still on ann); dan is only Claude Code's account.
  5. 05/menubar: shows no Switch account › and no other account in either menu (the Dock menu too): ann is in use and filtered off standby, ben is Claude Code's. The Switch page in the same state offers "Switch back to ann…" next to ann marked IN USE. The table says 05: the menus, the card and the page should offer the same next step.
  6. 07/menubar: shows the submenu line "✓ ann in use · week 55%" (both menus): 55% is Claude Code's week on dan, given to ann without the "Claude Code on dan" note the row above it carries. The table says A: the numbers say whose they are on every surface.
  7. 05/card: shows the same reset said two ways: the card "in 3 days" (and "Resets in 3 days"), the menu bar row "in 4d 0h"; in 07 "in 4 days" against "in 5d 0h"; in 02 Fable "in 6 h 59 min" against "in 7h 0m". The table says one record, one reset time: every surface should round it the same way (A).
  8. 06/switch: shows with the Claude app already signed in to ben, the page still says "Open Main's Claude window and sign it in to ben" (Back) and "Open it and sign it in to ben yourself" (What changed ▸ Claude window). The table says 06: done, ben in use everywhere; nothing left for the person to do.
  9. 10/switch: shows the partly-undone line names a raw entry file ("local_<id>.json was left as it was"); the status strip still says "STOPPED · UNDO PUTS IT BACK" and the keys are Try again and Undo the move. Leave it as it is is only on the Sessions card. The table says 10: says partly undone and what was left in words; Undo again and Leave it as it is offered together (B4).
  10. 09/switch: shows Try again is the first key of a switch that stopped part way (2 sessions under ben, 4 under ann), beside Undo the move; the Sessions card in the same state offers Undo it, Leave it as it is and Not now, never Try again. The table says 09: Undo offered; the page and the Sessions card should offer the same keys (B4).
  11. 11/switch: shows with Main's folder gone, the page still offers Try again, and its steps shrink to the three of a sign-in only (no window close, no move) unlike 03's five for the same switch. The card, both menus and Settings show ann in use with her numbers and Switch to ben, with no word of the gone folder (the agent's next read is not drawn). The table says 11: refused before anything, said once and the same everywhere (A, B4); no key that would only fail again.
  12. 04a/switch: shows the account switched to is labelled three ways across the rows: "TO" with a TO badge (02, 03, 12), "WANTED" with a STANDBY badge (04a, 04b, 07–11), "NEXT" with a TO badge (04c). The table says 03: NOW ann, TO ben; the same words through every step (B).
  13. 04b/menubar + 04b/card: shows while sessions are moving (step 2), the card and the menu bar show no sign a switch is running: ann in use, ben 'Standby · last in use 3 days ago', and the menu bar's Switch account › still offers ben as a target, so a second switch can be started mid-run. The table says 04: a switch is running; every surface says so (Switching to ben…) and no other switch can start until it ends (B, §8).
  14. rows 02 → 03/04 (fixture): shows row 02 has ann's week full (the reason to switch), but rows 03 and 04 show ann's week at 40% (card 'wk 40'), so the reason for the switch disappears between rows. The table says atlas fixture continuity: rows 03–04 keep row 02's full week until the switch ends (a harness fix, not an app bug).
